title: East Jessamine Middle School
subtitle: charleston, sc february 25-27, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for East Jessamine Middle School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Historic Downtown Charleston & Charleston Guided Ghost Tour

  • Travel to Charleston!
  • Arrival in Charleston! Meet your Tour Director!
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Historic Downtown Charleston
  • Charleston Guided Ghost Tour
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (two nights)
 

Day 2: Fort Sumter & Charles Town Landing Historic Park

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit Fort Sumter and Fort Moultrie 
  • Visit Sullivan’s Lighthouse 
  • Admission to the Patriot Point Naval & Maritime Museum 
  • Picnic Lunch 
  • Visit Charles Town Landing Historic Park 
  • Visit the Citadel and Battery Tour 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit Shem Creek
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Charleston Museum & Departure Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit City Market
  • Visit the Charleston Museum 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Departure Home
introHeading: East Jessamine Middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Charleston adventure in 2027! ☀️
introText: From cobblestone streets and historic landmarks to waterfront views and fascinating museums, this Charleston, South Carolina experience brings history to life at every turn. Students will explore the heart of downtown Charleston, visit important sites like Fort Sumter and Charles Towne Landing, and discover the city’s rich maritime past at Patriots Point. With memorable experiences like a ghost tour, time along Shem Creek, and visits to iconic Charleston attractions, this trip offers the perfect blend of history, culture, and excitement—an experience your students will never forget!
